name: Testimonial Image Wheel
summary: A testimonial block with a heading, review count, average rating and country count, and a slowly turning ring of avatars. The active review flies out of the ring beside its quote.
useWhen: A landing page section where each customer is shown as a face, with a handful of reviews that cycle through
Social proof that should feel alive and still lets a reader pick any customer to read their quote
avoidWhen: Readers need to compare many reviews at once; use a grid or list of testimonials
The avatars must show real faces at a readable size; the 38px avatars only fit initials or small illustrations
There is only one quote to show; a plain blockquote is simpler
